compiled_state.title: T3(UPDATE): Update review-defenses.md to add optional cited_lines field to DefenseRecord
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Update the review-defenses.md contract to document cited_lines as an optional field in the DefenseRecord shape. This contract update must land before T4 (implementation) since T4's behavior relies on this field.

## File
plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md

## Change
Add a new row to the Record Shape table (after the existing cited_lines_fingerprint row):

| cited_lines | array of strings | no | List of file:line references copied from the defended finding's cited_lines field. Format: 'file/path.py:42'. When present, enables ±5-line proximity-matching suppression in _suppress_defended_findings (runner.py). When absent, the matcher falls back to description[:80] comparison. |

## Also document
- This field is populated by the REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md orchestrator when assembling the defense_json before calling defense_store_write
- review-defense-store.sh already preserves cited_lines passthrough when included in the input defense_json
- mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh forwards whatever JSON is in stored records, so no changes needed to the shell scripts

## Acceptance
- Row exists in the Record Shape table in review-defenses.md
- Text of the description matches the proximity matcher contract (±5 lines, fallback behavior)
- Additive change only: no existing required fields modified
